summary: This MS is open only to students already in the Oceans PhD, and the Bulletin says its requirements vary by student. The audit counts the 45 units; the department checks your individual requirements by hand.

rBfECaVM.why: "The OCEANS-MS program is only open to existing students in the OCEANS-PHD Program. Requirements vary by student." Individually set requirements are a department sign-off, not information.

patch.name: Requirements set individually with the department
